Response that includes tool call output items

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
api_key = ENV.fetch("API_KEY")
client = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = client.create_response_async(LiterLlm::CreateResponseRequest.new(input: 'What is the weather in San Francisco?', model: 'gpt-4o', tools: [{ 'description' => 'Get current weather for a location', 'name' => 'get_weather', 'parameters' => { 'properties' => { 'location' => { 'type' => 'string' } }, 'required' => ['location'], 'type' => 'object' }, 'type' => 'function' }]))
puts result.id.inspect
puts result.status.inspect
puts result.output.inspect
```
